terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.draft: Draft ? requires legal review before publication
terms.intro: This draft describes the basic rules for using the Usta Rotam automotive service directory.

purpose.title: Platform purpose
purpose.body: Usta Rotam helps users discover mechanics and auto services by location, specialty and available information.

accounts.title: User accounts
accounts.body: Users must provide accurate, current information and protect their account credentials.

workshops.title: Mechanic and service information
workshops.body: Profile information may come from businesses or public sources. Correction requests may be evaluated for accuracy.

responsibilities.title: User responsibilities
responsibilities.body: Users must use the platform lawfully, honestly and without infringing third-party rights.

reviews.title: Reviews and ratings
reviews.body: Reviews must reflect real experiences and must not contain misleading, abusive, personal or manipulative content.

prohibited.title: Prohibited use
prohibited.body: Unauthorized access, automated abuse, fake accounts, fraud, harmful content and service disruption are prohibited.

scope.title: Service scope
scope.body: Usta Rotam is a directory and, unless explicitly stated, is not a party to bookings, payments, warranties or repair services.

closure.title: Account closure
closure.body: Users may request account closure. Data is deleted or anonymized subject to legal and security retention needs.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.draft: Draft ? requires legal review before publication
privacy.intro: This draft describes personal data categories and core processing principles for Usta Rotam.

account.title: Account and contact data
account.body: Name, surname, email, optional phone and account information supplied by the user may be processed.

province.title: Province of residence
province.body: Province data may be processed to tailor local results and platform experience.

security.title: Session and security data
security.body: Session identifiers, security logs, device and connection data may be processed for account security, abuse prevention and troubleshooting.

interactions.title: Mechanic and service interactions
interactions.body: Favorites, reviews, ratings and service interactions may be processed to provide related features.

purposes.title: Processing purposes
purposes.body: Data may be processed for account management, service delivery, security, support, legal obligations and consent-based communications.

retention.title: Retention and deletion
retention.body: Data is retained for the necessary purpose, security needs and applicable legal periods, then deleted or anonymized.

rights.title: User rights
rights.body: Users may exercise applicable rights to access, correction, deletion, restriction and objection.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Controller name, address and privacy contact will be completed by authorized persons before publication: [NAME], [ADDRESS], [EMAIL].

about.paragraph1: Finding the right expertise can be a time-consuming and uncertain process for vehicle owners. Usta Rotam makes it easier to search by city, district, vehicle type and service category.
